follow-up time: Until subsequent live birth, maternal death, emigration, or end of study period (1982-2010)
exposure: Type of Caesarean section (emergency, elective, maternal-requested)
cohort: 832,996 women in Denmark with index live births between 1982 and 2010
finding: Caesarean section was associated with a reduced rate of subsequent live birth, particularly elective and maternal-requested Caesareans.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a reduction in the rate of subsequent live birth, particularly among elective and maternal-requested Cesareans.
